patterns.name: SQL Statement Injection In Request Parameters
patterns.basis: APT41 used SQL injection for initial access in C0017, APT28, APT39, Axiom, Agrius, Dragonfly, Night Dragon and Operation Digital Eye used SQL injection, and Havij and sqlmap automate it (T1190).

patterns.name: Script Tag Injection In Request Parameters
patterns.basis: Winter Vivern exploited Roundcube Webmail servers and the page cites the OWASP top 10 web flaws, no CVE for script injection is named on the page (T1190).

patterns.name: Operating System Command Injection Markers
patterns.basis: Cutting Edge exploited Ivanti Connect Secure command injection (CVE-2024-21887) and the Mexico government breach used remote command execution on an internet-facing server (T1190).

patterns.name: Directory Traversal Sequences In Request Paths
patterns.basis: APT41 exploited Citrix ADC directory traversal (CVE-2019-19781) and traversal flaws in C0017, APT29 and Dragonfly reused CVE-2019-19781 and FortiOS CVE-2018-13379 (T1190).

patterns.name: Remote Lookup String In Request Headers Or Parameters
patterns.basis: APT41 in C0017, C0018, Magic Hound and Cinnamon Tempest exploited Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) through remote lookup strings (T1190).

patterns.name: Serialized Object Payload In Request Data
patterns.basis: APT41 exploited Zoho ManageEngine unsafe deserialization (CVE-2020-10189), Blue Mockingbird exploited Telerik CVE-2019-18935 and FIN13 used WebSphere SOAP deserialization CVE-2015-7450 (T1190).

patterns.name: Expression Language Injection In Request Parameters
patterns.basis: FIN13 exploited Primefaces expression language injection (CVE-2017-1000486), Ember Bear exploited Confluence CVE-2021-26084 and Rocke exploited Apache Struts (T1190).

patterns.name: Server Side Request Forgery Toward Internal Targets
patterns.basis: Cutting Edge chained Ivanti SSRF CVE-2024-21893, the Anthropic AI-orchestrated Campaign targeted an SSRF flaw, and the page names the Cloud Instance Metadata API as a follow-up (T1190).

patterns.name: Known Vulnerability Scanner Or Checking Tool Trace
patterns.basis: sqlmap and Havij are listed as automated SQL injection tools and Volatile Cedar used automatic vulnerability discovery against public web servers (T1190).

patterns.name: Known Exploit Endpoint Followed By Web Shell Or Command Execution
patterns.basis: SharePoint ToolShell Exploitation used crafted POST requests to ToolPane.aspx (CVE-2025-49704), the Mexico breach planted a web shell, and BlackByte and APT41 used ProxyLogon and ProxyShell (T1190).
